text: Figure 9.26: Example of an informative Introduction for a PortPrototype Interface: The Interface field of a PortPrototype definition contains the reference to the interface definition ( 9.8)which describes the properties of the information which is exchanged by the port. In the selection list of the field all defined interfaces are collected and can be referenced. The interface typifies the properties of the ports content.
